title: RC520 native IG831T AT/QMI startup evidence

scope.collection: Passive observation of stock services following one explicitly authorized controller reboot
scope.timing_origin: First logged native AT command; all published timings are elapsed milliseconds in the same stable-clock segment
scope.clock_limit: The full boot file includes pre-clock-correction records. Collector lifetime exceeds retained protocol log coverage; no continuous multi-minute protocol claim.
scope.source_visibility: Underlying captures and proprietary artifacts remain private; this curated evidence does not include raw frames, payload hashes, file paths or response identities.

at.selection_evidence: Native RIL table/helper plus explicit logged AT-port selection and subsequent same-process exchanges
at.correlation: Same process, nearest outstanding logged request; no overlap or unmatched terminal in the scoped AT log. Reader and sender may use different threads. Unsolicited response-body lines are not treated as independent solicited successes.
at.counting_rule: One logged command line is one unit. Combined COPS format/query lines are not expanded into multiple catalog events.

qmi.service_version_limit: Advertisements describe this specimen and session. They are not library release versions, a required exact fingerprint, proof every service works, or proof of NR capability.
qmi.only_captured_indication: WDS packet-service state becomes CONNECTED; no unsolicited CTL Sync indication is captured

wda.consumer: The selected native code tests the returned link-layer value for RAW_IP and stores its raw-IP state; it does not require response equality with the Ethernet request.
wda.namespace_warning: Request TLV0x17 is an8-byte endpoint selector; response0x17 is a4-byte uplink datagram limit. The response value16 is not an interface number.

wds.absence_limit: The bounded log covers native startup with the connection left in use. It is not a measured teardown attempt or a cleanup-failure claim.

source_supported_lifecycle.ctl_sync: Selected native initializer can send up to ten Sync requests,1000ms response timeout with1-second delay after failure. Two requests separated2000ms were observed; second reply arrives30ms later. This is native policy, not a general QMI initialization requirement.
source_supported_lifecycle.version_request: Native Version request includes service-selection TLV0x01,one-byte value255.
source_supported_lifecycle.version_tolerance: Selected scan runs only with nonzero QMAP context, uses fixed result/count offsets and tests WDA minor>16 for a feature flag; the inspected comparison does not check the major version or all29entries for exact equality. With zero context this scan is skipped.
source_supported_lifecycle.cid_allocation: One client each for WDS,DMS,NAS,UIM,WDA; observed later requests use their allocated clients.
source_supported_lifecycle.internal_ipv6_index: A source-only internal index0x11 is rewritten to wire WDS service0x01. It is not a request to wire service0x11 for IPv6. No IPv6 Start was captured.
source_supported_lifecycle.start_handle: Separate family-specific packet-data handles are stored on successful Start; source Start timeout120000ms. Device-mandated necessity of this timeout is not proven.
source_supported_lifecycle.stop_handle: Source Stop sends only a nonzero stored family-specific handle using a30000ms timeout and clears the stored handle after successful result. No Stop was observed in this capture.
source_supported_lifecycle.release: Source deinitialization iterates nonzero client slots and emits CTLRelease, then clears local slots; local clearing alone must not be reported as an acknowledged remote release.
source_supported_lifecycle.profile_changes: Conditional code can create/modify a QMI profile or change AT context and cycle modem function state. These branches were not observed here; the observed MGAUTH configuration is separate.
source_supported_lifecycle.reconnect: Selected main-loop branches poll state, repeat setup/deactivation and can request operating-mode recovery. This does not license a proxy to reproduce mutations or unbounded retries.
source_supported_lifecycle.dtr: Native USB DTR assertion/value/clear timing is UNKNOWN. No application QMI frame or AT&D2 establishes the EP0 transfer.

parser_constraints.matching: Selected native response matcher compares service,client,TID, using8-bit CTL transactions and16-bit service transactions; no explicit message-ID/response-flag gate is established in that selected match branch. Offline validation applies stronger matching.
parser_constraints.unknown_tlvs: Selected lookup loops skip unneeded well-formed TLVs by length+3. This is not universal arbitrary-TLV-order tolerance.
parser_constraints.fixed_offsets: Several result,version-count and handle readers use fixed offsets; preserve mandatory response semantics and do not infer a full schema-driven native parser.
parser_constraints.bounds: Selected TLV loops do not show an explicit value-length<=remaining check before16-bit remaining arithmetic. This is a bounded static observation, not a tested exploit, safety certification or permission to replay malformed input.
parser_constraints.adapter_implication: Use bounded framing and explicit response matching; preserve unknown well-formed TLVs without inventing success.
